title: Concentration and Nucleic Acid Extraction of Viruses from Airplane Waste
author: Ari N Machtinger
materials: Gather the materials and reagents for the Zymo quick-DNA/RNA Viral Kit in the Biosafety Cabinet. Equilibrate samples to room temperature. Refer to the "Guidelines" section for instructions on processing and handling RNA samples.

Gather the materials and reagents for the Zymo quick-DNA/RNA Viral Kit in the Biosafety Cabinet. Equilibrate samples to room temperature. Refer to the "Guidelines" section for instructions on processing and handling RNA samples.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % Tween 20 stock
steps.instruction: Combine 4 mL Tween 20 with 36 mL 1X PBS in a 40 mL container, filter‑sterilize through a 0.22 µm vacuum filter; this yields enough 10 % (v/v) Tween 20/PBS for ~20 dissociation treatments.

steps.title: Transfer waste to fume hood
steps.instruction: Following the Safety Warnings, move the refrigerated airplane‑waste sample (still in its secondary container) to the fume hood, remove it from the secondary container and peel off the Parafilm seal.

steps.title: Aliquot waste and controls
steps.instruction: Invert the waste bottle to resuspend, then using a fresh 50 mL serological pipette dispense 20 mL waste into each of two 50 mL centrifuge tubes (one replicate). For each negative‑control replicate add 20 mL 1X PBS to two tubes. Keep total volume per tube ≤40 mL.

steps.title: Add PBS and Tween to tubes
steps.instruction: To each centrifuge tube add 18 mL 1X PBS and 2 mL of the 10 % Tween 20 stock solution; this gives a final Tween‑20 concentration of 5 % (v/v) and brings each tube to 40 mL total volume.

steps.title: Seal and store bottles
steps.instruction: Cap and Parafilm all centrifuge tubes and the original waste bottle, return the waste bottle to secondary containment, wipe exposed surfaces with pre‑empt wipes, and place the bottle back in refrigeration.

steps.title: Vortex samples
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on a vortexer with a 50 mL tube adapter and vortex at maximum speed for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

steps.title: Sonicate samples
steps.instruction: Transfer the tubes to a sonication bath, sonicate for 1 minute (00:01:00) at 40 kHz, then dry each tube with a paper towel.

steps.title: Prepare filtration units
steps.instruction: For each waste‑sample tube set up one pre‑filter/filter unit (2 units per waste replicate). For each negative‑control replicate set up one pre‑filter/filter unit. Place a 2 µm pre‑filter into a 0.45 µm vacuum filtration cup, ensuring the filter is flush, centered, and correctly oriented (use tweezers).

steps.title: Vacuum‑filter waste samples
steps.instruction: Attach a fresh filter unit to a clean pyrex bottle, filter each 40 mL waste tube separately (using a new filter for each tube), and collect all filtrate into the same pyrex bottle (total ≈80 mL).

steps.title: Replace filter after waste run
steps.instruction: When filtration is complete, turn off the vacuum, replace the used pre‑filter/filter unit with a fresh one attached to the same pyrex bottle, decant the second waste tube into the new filtration cup, resume vacuum filtration, then cap the pyrex bottle. Seal the spent filtration cup in a bag before discarding to biowaste.

steps.title: Vacuum‑filter negative control
steps.instruction: Attach a pre‑filter/filter unit to a clean 100 mL pyrex bottle, decant the negative‑control tube(s) into the filtration cup, vacuum‑filter (filtrate rate may be slow), then cap the bottle and set aside.

steps.title: Start‑up InnovaPrep pipette
steps.instruction: Turn on the InnovaPrep Concentrating Pipette Select, navigate to Maintenance → Start‑up, confirm the maintenance tip is installed, position the waste line, remove the storage‑fluid line, insert the foam elution canister, and verify the screen reads “WWULTRA”.

steps.title: Concentrate waste sample
steps.instruction: Remove the maintenance tip, insert a fresh Ultra CPT tip, lower the tip to the bottom of the waste tube (balance the bottle on its edge if needed; a PBS bottle can serve as a weight), press “Start Run” and let the pipette aspirate (~5 min) until it beeps indicating air. While holding a 5 mL centrifuge tube under the tip, press “Elute” and collect the dispensed foam.

steps.title: Add Zymo shield to eluate
steps.instruction: After the foam degasses, add 400 µL Zymo DNA/RNA Shield reagent to the eluate (1:1 sample:reagent ratio); the eluate volume will be ~400 µL.

steps.title: Concentrate negative control
steps.instruction: Repeat the concentration protocol for the negative‑control sample, using a fresh tip.

steps.title: Incubate with Zymo shield
steps.instruction: Incubate all shield‑treated samples at room temperature for 30 minutes (00:30:00). If incubation exceeds this time, store samples at 4 °C.

steps.title: Shut‑down InnovaPrep pipette
steps.instruction: Navigate to Maintenance → Shut Down, place the maintenance tip back into the tip port, remove the foam elution canister, ensure the storage‑fluid line is re‑connected, turn off the device, and remove the waste line.

steps.title: Add viral buffer and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 1 600 µL Viral DNA/RNA Buffer to each sample (2:1 buffer:sample ratio) and vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 µL of lysate into a Zymo‑Spin IIC‑XLR column placed in a collection tube, centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 2 minutes, discard the flow‑through, and repeat with successive 700 µL aliquots until the entire lysate volume has been processed.

steps.title: Wash column – first buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Viral Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 30 seconds, discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column – second buffer
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous wash step with another 500 µL Viral Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 95‑100 % ethanol to the column, centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 1 minute to remove residual wash buffer.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean collection tube and centrifuge at 12 000 × g (room temperature) for 1 minute to eliminate remaining ethanol.

steps.title: Transfer column to tube
steps.instruction: Place the column into a 1.5 mL nuclease‑free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL DNase/RNase‑Free Water directly to the column matrix, incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 30 seconds to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Store extracted nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Place all eluates in a –80 °C freezer. Optionally quantify RNA with the Qubit HS RNA assay or DNA with the Qubit dsDNA HS assay before freezing.
